scope: Independent static review of the first native policy-query runner and its frozen protocol; no model, environment, API, installation, checkpoint import, or hash checks performed by this review.

reviewed_final_changes: Validate each leaf of nested checkpoint optimizer PyTrees while preserving the complete variables tree; do not coerce each top-level optimizer value into a single ndarray.
Use the loaded checkpoint with Ninjax create=False, record consumed inference keys, and check explicit expected inference-parameter shapes.
JIT native policy_initial to respect the configured transfer guard without dummy training initialization.
Seed the actual first underlying environment reset, rather than seed a discarded reset followed by an unseeded reset.
Preserve the native constructor and first-policy NumPy RNG draw sequence; preserve both native task and exploration behavior calls.
Preserve the native six CEM rounds, 500 candidates, horizon 15, 50 elites, FP16, original cost threshold, mean update, and native returned action.
Record actual prior-sampling RNG keys without additional random draws; append the uint32 key after the native prior cast so scan output preserves its dtype.
Determine padded elite selection by the selected output position in the fixed-size filtered array being at or beyond safe_count, not by candidate index zero alone.
Record interrupted JIT inner-round and imagined-transition counts as unknown/null, rather than assume zero.
Use an isolated native_query_attempt1 output and retain the re-exec helper for the installed CUDA library and PTX paths.

resource_controls.external_timeout_reason: A Python signal alone may not interrupt a long XLA/CUDA operation immediately.

execution_status.basis: Resource-owner and root terminal report; this review did not execute or re-import the runner.
execution_status.setup_outcome: Package installation for the pinned official Safety-Gymnasium environment exceeded the 900-second setup deadline and was terminated before model or environment scientific execution.

interpretation_limits: Static approval is not evidence that checkpoint loading, numerical calibration, native planning, or the environment has executed successfully.
The fixed seed-zero root is a preregistered development feasibility instance; held-out membership and independent generalization are not established.
The planned independent final-round exact calibration remains a prerequisite for interpreting any subsequent shared-sampler intervention.
The separate replay implementation remains compile-only and unexecuted; its full implementation was not reviewed in this artifact.
A setup resource stop supplies neither Clean failure nor a scientific null for the proposed mode-mediated effect.

review_activity.persistence_note: This artifact persists the already-completed review; no additional experiment or broad audit was performed.
